title: Graph neural network predicts melting temperatures from minerals to new materials
summary: A graph neural network and residual network trained on a database of about 10,000 compounds predicts melting temperature quickly. The abstract reports that it found novel multicomponent materials with high melting points, confirmed by density functional theory calculations and experiments, and that it was used to analyse the melting temperatures of about 4,800 minerals. The number of experimentally tested compounds is not given in the abstract.
ai_technology: Graph neural network and residual neural network trained on about 10,000 compounds

evidence.tested: Predicted high-melting multicomponent materials confirmed by density functional theory and experiments; analysis of about 4,800 minerals.
evidence.unknown: Number of experimentally tested compounds not stated in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
